description: A Tough As Nails mod thirst and body temp HUD tweak for Prominence 2

mods.name: TAN HUD Tweaks
mods.description: Moves the Tough As Nails thirst + temperature HUD (tuned for Prominence II). Shows thirst inside the Dynamic Resource Bars hunger bar, or as its own blue bar. Settings: config/tanhudtweaks.json

releases.notes:
A simple patch mod for those of us wanting to throw [Tough As Nails](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tough-as-nails) by TheAdubbz into the [Prominience II: Hasturian Era](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/prominence-2-hasturian-era) pack by Cinderstone Studios (which, if you aren't playing, you should... and also why are you here?). It turns the thirst droplets into a blue bar that shares a HUD frame with the hunger bar, and puts the body temp tracker to the right of the hotbar.

First and foremost, full disclosure: Claude AI made this. I do not and cannot code. Anyone who wants to actually human-code this, please do! I'm just putting this here for anyone who might be able to use it, niche though it is.

Please note: This is an unofficial patch and in no way affiliated with any of the mod creators or anyone who made anything.
